item.title: Optical imaging links altered metabolism and oxygen use in Alzheimer's disease
item.description: Alzheimer's disease is best known for its effects on memory and cognition, but the disease also involves changes in how brain cells produce and use energy. Understanding how these processes interact could help researchers characterize metabolic changes that accompany the disease. Fuente: Phys.org.
